evidence: Running a minimal TransformerWrapper with attn_kv_heads=2, attn_qk_norm=True, and attn_qk_norm_dim_scale=True raises RuntimeError at codebase/x_transformers/x_transformers.py:1172: 'The size of tensor a (2) must match the size of tensor b (4) at non-singleton dimension 1'.
